SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.PRECEDENCE.Name: Precedence
SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.PRECEDENCE.Hint: Who has the last word where the game system and the Advanced modules both set the same thing, such as a class or a rule. The game system's own choices are kept by default; the Advanced modules take over what they can when the other is chosen. Reload to apply.
SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.WATCH.Name: Warn about changes to Foundry's registries
SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.WATCH.Hint: Warn in the console when a module or system replaces or deletes something another one put in CONFIG. Nothing is blocked or changed.
SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.WATCHLOG.Name: Log every change to Foundry's registries
SETTINGS.ADVANCED_CORE.WATCHLOG.Hint: Print each write to CONFIG with who made it, to find the writes Foundry itself makes. Noisy; for developers.
